skills.name: suite-des-grauens
skills.description: The Skill Suite of Horrors: nineteen short cheat sheets for the traps every Claude session on Windows steps into - backslashes, CRLF, escape codes, broken tables, spaces in paths, $ in strings, lost exit codes, empty arguments, case-only twins, service accounts not there yet, two processes on one file, messages that overtake each other, misheard dictation, German Windows. Read it on "bad interpreter: /bin/bash^M", ←[0m or \x1b in output, â”€ in a table, Windows looking for "C:\Program", error 1053 or 1332, "Variable reference is not valid", "argument is null or empty", a test pipe green while tests fail, "being used by another process", a dictated name the project does not know, German account names like Jeder, [double]::Parse giving 15, curl, sc or where doing something else in PowerShell, Copy-Item copying backwards, or a path reported missing that is there. Read the table, then only the one sheet that fits. Optional, best taken with a smile.
